company.shortDescription: Deep24 provides an AI coach that connects to personal data sources to generate plans for life improvement.
company.description: Deep24 provides an AI coach that connects to a wide range of personal data sources to understand user habits, goals, and behavior. The platform analyzes information from these sources to build a holistic profile of each user. Based on this understanding, Deep24 generates structured plans and recommendations aimed at improving different aspects of a user’s life, such as wellness, productivity, and learning. The service is designed for individuals seeking ongoing guidance rather than one-time advice. Deep24 uses artificial intelligence to adapt its coaching as new data becomes available and user circumstances change.
